macros.name: colorA
macros.doc: To use the current user colours elsewhere in the document, access these as \colorA and \colorB.

macros.name: colorB
macros.doc: To use the current user colours elsewhere in the document, access these as \colorA and \colorB.

macros.name: hexboard
macros.doc: The basic usage is via \hexboard{num} which draws a Hex board of size num by num.

macros.name: hexbottomsubborder
macros.doc: The command \hexbottomsubborder{start}{end} draws a bottom border from column start to column end.

macros.name: hexcell
macros.doc: An individual cell is drawn using \hexcell{x}{y}.

macros.name: hexcellshaded
macros.doc: The command \hexcellshaded{x}{y} is used to draw a shaded cell.

macros.name: hexcellshaded
macros.doc: The command \hexcellshaded{x}{y} is used to draw a shaded cell.

macros.name: hexconnect
macros.doc: The command \hexconnect{x1}{y1}{x2}{y2} draws a line from cell (x1,y1) to cell (x2,y2).

macros.name: hexcontent
macros.doc: The command \hexcontent{x}{y}{content} puts content into cell (x,y).

macros.name: hexcontent
macros.doc: The command \hexcontent{x}{y}{content} puts content into cell (x,y).

macros.name: hexdot
macros.doc: To indicate a position on the board using a small dot, use \hexdot{x}{y}.

macros.name: hexgrid
macros.doc: The command \hexgrid{columns}{rows} is used to draw a grid of that size.

macros.name: hexgridnolabel
macros.doc: The command \hexgridnolabel{columns}{rows} is used to draw a grid of that size without edge labels.

macros.name: hexreducing
macros.doc: The command \hexreducing{columns}{rows} draws a grid with a bottom border only that starts at columns wide but decreases width by 1 each row until it has drawn rows rows.

macros.name: hexscale
macros.doc: The basic unit of the diagrams can be scaled using \hexscale{number}.

macros.name: hexshadedsubrow
macros.doc: The command \hexshadedsubrow{start}{end}{row} draws a partial row of shaded cells from column start to column end on row row.

macros.name: hexskipmove
macros.doc: A command \hexskipmove is used to increment the move counter without placing a piece, which can be used to skip player A’s first move if player B is to move first (including, for example, if the swap rule has been used but you wish to maintain labelling that shows the order in which pieces were placed).

macros.name: hexsubrow
macros.doc: The command \hexsubrow{start}{end}{row} draws a partial row of cells from column start to column end on row row.

macros.name: setcolorA
macros.doc: Player A’s colour can be set using \setcolorA{color} and player B’s colour can be set using \setcolorB{color}.

macros.name: setcolorB
macros.doc: Player A’s colour can be set using \setcolorA{color} and player B’s colour can be set using \setcolorB{color}.

envs.name: hexpicture
envs.doc: Hex boards are drawn inside an environment called hexpicture.
